findings.description: Parameters without '=' are now stored with the boolean value True instead of being skipped, so get_encoding_from_headers can call .strip() on a bool.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a response header like 'Content-Type: text/html; charset' (charset with no value). The new code sets params_dict['charset'] = True, so get_encoding_from_headers reaches params['charset'].strip('"\'') on a bool and raises AttributeError. Before this change the param was ignored and the code fell back to ISO-8859-1. Impact: a malformed but server-sent header makes response.encoding or .text raise instead of decoding.
